Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Jack. He was three years old and loved to play. One day, Jack was playing with his toy car, and he was having lots of fun. Suddenly, he saw a big, scary monster! He was so scared that he ran away.
Jack was scared and ran away, but he was still scared. He ran away, but the monster was too fast. Jack was too scared to go away. He ran away, but the monster was too fast
